= Azure Storage Queue Service
:artifactid: camel-azure-storage-queue-starter

Send messages to and receive messages from the queues of Azure Queue Storage.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::azure-storage-queue-component.adoc[Azure Storage Queue Service component], URI syntax: `azure-storage-queue:accountName/queueName`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-azure-storage-queue-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
